retrievalProfile.description: A layered paper collage aesthetic featuring a central portrait partially obscured by a textured cutout shape, framed by hands holding the composition.
excludeWhen: clean digital photography without physical texture

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition where a central figure in sunglasses is viewed through a map-shaped cutout in a blue textured card, held by hands at the top, all set against a white background with a drop shadow effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Hands at the top corners appear to hold the inner blue frame
The map cutout acts as a window to the subject's eyes
Drop shadows create a physical depth between the white background and the blue card
The subject's body is visible below the blue card, creating a continuous figure
coreInvariants: Textured blue card with a geographic cutout
Visible hands interacting with the frame edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the subject, framed by the cutout, serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the script text at the top, move down to the face in the cutout, and follow the hands to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space surrounds the central collage element, emphasizing the 'object' quality of the art.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White background providing a clean, gallery-like setting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blue textured card providing a cool mid-tone.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red accents in the bottom typography and warm skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark clothing/sunglasses and the bright white background.

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Fluid, connected script with varying line weight and long flourishes.
Bottom text: Wide-tracked, all-caps geometric sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'P' and 'S' in the script have large, sweeping loops.
The bottom text uses a small red square as a separator.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of expressive, organic script with rigid, mechanical sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric sans-serif at the bottom

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage of a man in sunglasses behind a blue textured card with a USA-shaped cutout, held by hands against a white background with drop shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large white script title with a red outline at the top, and a wide-tracked blue sans-serif subtitle at the bottom separated by a red square.

verificationChecks: Is the script text outlined in red?
Is the bottom text extremely wide-tracked?
Does the blue card have a visible paper texture?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact geographic borders of the cutout
postGenerationChecks: Verify the script text is legible against the background
Ensure the hands look like they are gripping the card
Confirm the wide tracking on the bottom text
